summary: Multi-task lifecycle, per-task config, batch operations, and per-task locking are implemented cleanly across agentloop/tasks.py, agentloop/locks.py, agentloop/cli.py, agentloop/workflow.py, and agentloop/runner.py. Per-task state under .agentloop/tasks/<id>/state.json is the source of truth; runs/ and locks/ are namespaced per task; the legacy global state.json is preserved as a backwards-compatible pointer/mirror only when the affected task is current. CLI exposes resolver-aware single-task commands (positional or --task-id) plus a tasks subgroup with batch approve/cancel/run, config show/set/unset/clear, unlock, migrate, and selectors (--task-id/--all/--status) that surface per-task ok/error rows without aborting the batch. Per-task config supports test_commands, max_iterations, default_runtime, and roles.<role>.runtime with documented precedence. docs/agentloop-design.md §23 documents storage layout, concurrency model, precedence, and CLI surface. tests/test_multitask.py covers all functional ACs with hermetic temp-workspace tests using the manual runtime.

acceptance_results.evidence: agentloop/tasks.py:save_task_state mirrors to legacy only when current; workflow.start_task/approve_task/cancel_task/run_one_iteration use load_task_state + save_task_state for per-task IO.
tests/test_multitask.py::test_start_allows_multiple_concurrent_tasks; start_task no longer gates on legacy state.status.
tasks.resolve_task_id branches on active count; tests test_ambiguous_bare_command_lists_candidates and test_bare_command_works_with_single_active.
runner.run_test_commands(task_id=...) and adapters.run_role(task_id=...) namespace under runs/<task_id>/<iteration>/; test_run_namespaces_logs_per_task asserts per-task run dirs.

agentloop/locks.py uses os.O_CREAT|O_EXCL with PID/host payload, stale reclaim via _pid_alive; cli.cmd_run wraps in task_lock(blocking=wait) and exits 2 with LockHeld; test_run_fails_fast_when_task_locked verifies.
tasks.effective_config deep-merges per-task override over global config; ALLOWED_TOP_KEYS = {test_commands, max_iterations, roles, default_runtime}; documented in docs/agentloop-design.md §23.4.
cli tasks config show/set/unset/clear subcommands; tests test_per_task_test_commands_override_takes_effect and test_config_show_returns_override_and_effective.
cmd_tasks_batch_approve/cancel/run + _run_batch_op return per-task (status,tid,message) and _print_batch_summary returns 1 if any failed; test_batch_cancel_isolates_failures verifies.
cmd_tasks_config_set uses _resolve_selection (--task-id/--all/--status); test_batch_config_set_all asserts override is written to every task.
docs/agentloop-design.md §23 (lines 857-964) documents storage, source-of-truth, concurrency/locking, per-task config precedence, and full CLI surface.

tasks.migrate_workspace is idempotent, copies legacy state into per-task file, relocates legacy numeric runs/ dirs under current task; lazily invoked in cli.main; test_migration_copies_legacy_state_into_per_task_file verifies.
